81087.subject: 🦍 Yuga launches trading cards
81087.body:
———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $82,332 (0.4%) | **ETH** $2,421 (0.2%) | **SOL** $105 (0.9%)

* US crypto ETFs post [$610.7M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/spot-bitcoin-etf-weekly-outflows-s2fpgw4) in net outflows for the week of Oct 12-16

* Nasdaq 100 closes the week down [5.5%](https://x.com/bespokeinvest/status/2111185589860995180), its largest decline since April 2025

* Brent Crude jumps [over $108](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/BZ=F/) as energy prices surge

* Yuga Labs launches [Mudwater](https://www.chooserich.live/story/yuga-labs-mudwater-solana-trading-cards-gwqcagf), physical BAYC cards with onchain Solana NFT twins

* JPMorgan launches its [deposit token](https://www.chooserich.live/story/jpmorgan-deposit-token-ethereum-7yj3w7b) on Ethereum

* Qubic halts its mainnet after a wallet drain empties [1,404 accounts](https://www.chooserich.live/story/qubic-halts-mainnet-wallet-drain-vjwit94)

* [Pump.fun](https://Pump.fun) adds Hyperliquid-powered [perpetual futures](https://www.chooserich.live/story/pumpfun-hyperliquid-perpetual-futures-trading-3jm3tfs) trading to its app

* Microsoft cancels its deal to anchor Nscale's Essex data center, scraps [23,000 Nvidia chips](https://www.chooserich.live/story/microsoft-cancels-nscale-datacenter-deal-zibdat6)

* a16z crypto releases [Aerie](https://www.chooserich.live/story/a16z-crypto-releases-aerie-7jvqse5), an open-source system for post-quantum signature aggregation

* OpenCode says a breach hit at least [1.4%](https://www.chooserich.live/story/opencode-breach-exposes-api-keys-skt3xae) of Console users, may expose provider keys

* Papertrade logs [$55.18M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/papertrade-hyperliquid-weekly-revenue-7njnk3b) in first-week revenue on Hyperliquid

* Anthropic's Jack Clark says AI could lift US GDP to [$44T](https://www.chooserich.live/story/anthropic-ai-us-gdp-forecast-mvwvvjj) by 2030

* Taiwan blocks access to Coinbase and Kalshi over suspected [election betting](https://www.chooserich.live/story/taiwan-blocks-coinbase-kalshi-pkk99py)

Cysic Foundation said an attacker exploited its cross-chain
bridge’s message-processing logic to mint 10 million CYS tokens
without authorisation on BNB Smart Chain on October 17. The
attacker routed roughly 7.2 million through DEX swaps before
Cysic blacklisted the address 76 minutes after the mint.

The bridge remains closed pending a full security review.
Existing user wallet balances were not affected.

How did on-chain data reviewed by CoinMarketCap confirm Cysic’s
account of the exploit?
